svg.text: One row per model, one cell per layer (same scale, so row length = depth). Measured from the weights only.
the last 9 layers are the loudest.
L8–27 run 4 times (192 blocks). Edit L3–7;
One LLM in base, VL, Audio, Omni, d1,
52% of the change is in the MLP;
Short memory early, long memory deep.
Only 8 of 32 layers keep a KV cache.
Dim-0 sink in every MLP. Candidates (not
yet probed): L15+16, L19. Keep L27, L31.
Gains peak at L7 (attn 47) and L23
Layout only, not magnitudes (see the measured layer profiles chart) · zone labels are interpretation, numbers are measured · surgery targets come from weights, not activations
